metadata.title: Galda Nakham | Dried Fish With Roselle
metadata.description:
Tweet to share this recipe: https://ctt.ec/q70fb

Galda Nakham is an authentic Garo (a'chik) dish which has a earthy, sour and tangy flavor. Galda stands Roselle, which is species of edible hibiscus plant and had a tangy sourness to it and Nakham stands for dried fish, usually the fresh water ones. 

It's a simple and easy dish to make and is very healthy. This dish goes really well with steamed rice.
